document_host.note: NEC 'Public Access' MVC — a NAMING COLLISION: this is not Idox Public Access and Recipe C does not apply to it. Constructible from the reference alone; the whole document chain is stateless and cold and works with any User-Agent.

quirks.summary: An ORIGIN WAF hard-403s Generic/StdResults.aspx for any request — Cloudflare here is passive and is not the cause.
quirks.detail: Default, empty and browser User-Agents all pass Cloudflare; the 403 is the origin's own rule and does not vary with UA.
quirks.workaround: Skip StdResults entirely: take XMLLoc from the search 302's Location header and GET that XML on the same cookie jar — its <PK> is PARAM0.

quirks.summary: The same origin WAF 403s any POST whose body contains an empty cboSelectDateValue.
quirks.workaround: Send the minimal reference-lookup field set only; every extra empty field is WAF bait.

quirks.summary: The document list is not markup — it is a JavaScript object literal embedded in the page: var model = {...Rows:[{Guid,Doc_Type,Date_Received,Doc_Ref2}]}.
Date_Received in that model is US format, MM/DD/YYYY — read as dd/mm it yields a plausible wrong date and nothing reports an error.
quirks.workaround: Parse as MM/DD/YYYY. Only dates whose first component exceeds 12 are self-evident, so do not rely on spotting them.

quirks.summary: The download parameter must be named 'id'; the response has to be checked rather than trusted.
quirks.detail: Recorded together with an instruction to check Content-Type, i.e. a wrong parameter does not announce itself loudly and a non-PDF body can be saved under a .pdf name.
quirks.workaround: Verify Content-Type and magic bytes on every download.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

endpoints.note: Both are constructible from the reference / Guid alone: no session, no CSRF, no Referer, any User-Agent. The register side still needs the Recipe D2 VIEWSTATE round-trip, and its results page is WAF-blocked — see quirks. Host path casing is recorded as it was observed (PublicAccess_LIVE on search, PublicAccess_Live on download); it was not established whether the path is case-sensitive.

source_notes: PE alive (PlanIt area 234). Cloudflare PASSIVE (default/empty/browser UA all pass). ORIGIN WAF: (a) hard-403s Generic/StdResults.aspx for ANY request — use the XMLLoc-from-302 workaround (see vendor entry), <PK>=PARAM0; (b) 403s POSTs containing empty cboSelectDateValue — send minimal field set. DOCUMENTS BESPOKE, separate host: https://docs.runnymede.gov.uk/PublicAccess_LIVE/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=PL&FOLDER1_REF=<ref-with-literal-slash> (NEC 'Public Access' MVC — NOT Idox despite the name; constructible from ref alone). Doc list embedded in HTML as 'var model = {...Rows:[{Guid,Doc_Type,Date_Received,Doc_Ref2}]}' (US-format dates MM/DD/YYYY). Download: GET /PublicAccess_Live/Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid> -> PDF (param must be 'id'; check Content-Type). WHOLE doc chain stateless/cold, any UA. Ref format RU.YY/NNNN.
